title: Scorable Probe: consolidated NDCG/MRR telemetry, stratified prompt ingestion, and tail-latency hooks
creator: Elena Morales
description: Background: Customers pushing large rerank workloads report divergence between offline evals and production signal: NDCG/MRR drift, intermittent tail latency spikes during mixed-batch traffic, and inconsistent promptset ingestion. Goal: deliver a single lightweight probe ("scorable-probe") that (1) instruments per-request ranking signals required to compute NDCG and MRR at production scale, (2) provides stratified ingestion of customer prompt sets for consistent AB splits, and (3) attaches low-overhead tail-latency hooks and batch-context telemetry to the rerank endpoint. This ticket covers schema design, storage/ingest decisions, endpoint hooks, and rollout strategy (canary + AB slices).
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry schema defined and documented in Confluence: includes fields for customer_id, promptset_id, request_id, model_variant, batch_size, kv_cache_hit, token_count, compute_ms, wire_ms, total_latency_ms, ndcg_score (nullable), mrr_score (nullable), label_source
Endpoint instrumentation added to /v1/rerank: a) attach probe metadata to every candidate list request, b) non-blocking async emit to ingestion pipeline, c) <1% p50 added latency in local perf tests

Stratified ingestion pipeline implemented to honor customer-provided promptset IDs and deterministic AB slice assignment (hashing by request_id), and persists raw probe events to S3+Kafka topic for downstream evals
NDCG and MRR offline aggregation job (airflow) produces daily customer-sliced reports and exposes rolling 7d/30d deltas to the console dashboard
Canary rollout plan executed: 5% traffic for two customers for 48h, verify correctness and tail latency; automatic rollback if 99th percentile compute_ms increases by >20%
AB experiment hooks added: sample tags, experiment_id, variant_id present in probe events and surfaced to the AB platform
End-to-end instrumentation validated with synthetic promptsets (>=10k requests) and at least one real-customer promptset ingestion during staging
